name: FND_MAP_FLEX_DFF
description: Stores primary information about descriptive flexfields defined in source and their corresponding ones in Fusion

columns.name: MAP_ID
columns.description: Map Identifier

columns.name: S_TYPE
columns.description: Source

columns.name: S_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Source Application Id

columns.name: S_DFF_CODE
columns.description: Source Descriptive Flexfield Code

columns.name: S_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Source Table Name

columns.name: S_CONTEXT_COL_NAME
columns.description: Source Context Column Name

columns.name: T_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Target Application Id

columns.name: T_DFF_CODE
columns.description: Target Descriptive Flexfield Code

columns.name: T_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Target Table Name

columns.name: T_CONTEXT_COL_NAME
columns.description: Target Context Column Name

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: MAPPED_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate whether the source and target information are correctly mapped

columns.name: MIGRATED_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate whether the information is migrated over to target successfully

columns.name: FLEX_MIGRATED_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate whether the information is migrated over to target successfully with strongly typed migration.

columns.name: EFF_FLAG
columns.description: To differentiate the entries made for EFF and DFF

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
